high_level_description: The image is split into two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a fashion show scene. The setting appears to be an indoor venue with a modern, grid-like ceiling. The floor is wooden, and the audience is seated on both sides of a runway. The audience members are dressed in various outfits, some taking photos or videos with their phones. A few individuals are standing near the runway, possibly models or staff. The model walking down the runway is wearing a white, textured sweater with red accents and beige shorts.
